sql:
-- Final query: average pick percentage per product name, ordered by product name
WITH inv_totals AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.qty) as total_inv
    FROM inventory i
    GROUP BY i.product_id
),
order_lines_ordered AS (
    SELECT o.id as order_id, o.ordered, ol.product_id, ol.qty as order_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered, o.id) as order_seq
    FROM orders o
    JOIN orderlines ol ON o.id = ol.order_id
),
order_with_cumulative AS (
    SELECT product_id, order_qty, order_seq, order_id,
           SUM(order_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY order_seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cumulative_ordered
    FROM order_lines_ordered
),
order_with_prev AS (
    SELECT oc.*,
           LAG(cumulative_ordered) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY order_seq) as prev_cumulative_ordered
    FROM order_with_cumulative oc
),
order_picks AS (
    SELECT op.product_id, p.name, op.order_seq, op.order_id, op.order_qty,
           op.cumulative_ordered, op.prev_cumulative_ordered,
           it.total_inv,
           CASE 
               WHEN op.cumulative_ordered <= it.total_inv THEN op.order_qty
               WHEN op.prev_cumulative_ordered >= it.total_inv THEN 0.0
               ELSE it.total_inv - op.prev_cumulative_ordered
           END as picked_qty,
           CASE 
               WHEN op.cumulative_ordered <= it.total_inv THEN 1.0
               WHEN op.prev_cumulative_ordered >= it.total_inv THEN 0.0
               ELSE (it.total_inv - op.prev_cumulative_ordered) / op.order_qty
           END as pick_pct
    FROM order_with_prev op
    JOIN inv_totals it ON op.product_id = it.product_id
    JOIN products p ON op.product_id = p.id
)
SELECT name as product_name, 
       ROUND(AVG(pick_pct) * 100, 2) as avg_pick_percentage
FROM order_picks
GROUP BY name
ORDER BY name
